scope: Read-only audit of the 14 existing fire-lookout tags not matched by the OSM inventory. No database changes made by this audit.

records.name: Mebee Pass Lookout
records.note: FFLA confirms the cabin. The catalog coordinates are about 790 m southwest of the FFLA point and need separate location review. Do not widen all matching thresholds to handle this record.

records.name: Okanogan Post Office Lookout Site
records.note: FFLA lists this rooftop observation site under Lookout Sites / Non-lookout Structures.

records.name: Cobble Lookout
records.note: The land manager describes the Cobble Lookout trail ending at a rocky ledge with mountain views; the name denotes a natural viewpoint. This classification is an inference from that official trail description, not an explicit statement that no fire lookout ever existed.

records.name: Clearwater Lookout
records.note: Garfield County record. Do not confuse it with the gone Clearwater tower in Jefferson County.

records.name: Beacon Rock Lookout Site
records.note: FFLA places the former observation camp under Lookout Sites / Non-lookout Structures.

records.name: Darrington Ranger Station Lookout Site
records.note: The historic livery barn remains. The fire lookout added to its roof in 1932 does not.

records.name: Lorena Butte Lookout
records.note: The database points to the relocated cabin at Lefever, within 3 m of FFLA coordinates. The original Lorena Butte site at 45.80072,-120.79420 is Gone; that status must not be applied to the relocated cabin.

records.name: Leecher Crow's Nest Lookout Site

sources.sourceName: Mount Leecher Crows Nest, firsthand account by seasonal fire lookout Christine Estrada
Willhite Web firsthand photos and history

records.note: A separate historic 1918 tree-platform lookout southeast of the current Leecher tower, not the current enclosed tower. Both accounts document survival after the 2014 fire. No evidence supports removing this existing tag; the source observation is older than the audit date.

records.name: Harriets Peak Lookout

sources.sourceName: Willhite Web firsthand photos and history
sources.sourceStatus: Tower toppled by 2008; remains on the ground

records.note: The first account dates roof loss to winter 2006/07 and collapse discovery to 2008. The second confirms the fallen tower in July 2008. FFLA has no matching named row; this finding rests on independent firsthand photographic reports.
